# Winners Mark

> Bowling pro shop inside Valley Lanes in Taylorsville, Utah. Offers custom bowling ball drilling, resurfacing, grip and fit tuning, ball fitting, and equipment sales. Owned and operated by Matt Voeltz, master driller, as a dba of High Tech Bowling Pro Shop LLC.

- Address: Inside Valley Lanes, 3951 W 5400 S, Taylorsville, UT 84120
- Phone: (801) 808-6820
- Hours: Monday-Friday 12pm-8pm, Saturday 10am-5pm, Sunday 12pm-6pm
- Services: custom drilling, resurfacing, grip fitting, ball fitting, equipment sales, league accounts
- Owner & master driller: Matt Voeltz
